sources.excerpt: HM-3 Heavy Metal - **Builder:** Chaser - **Catalog type:** Distortion - **Identity:** Chaser HM-3 Heavy Metal, documented as a clone of the Boss HM-3 Hyper Metal. [1][2] - **Primary reference:** Boss **HM-3 Hyper Metal**. - The exact-model evidence establishes the clone relationship, but no Chaser-specific schematic or BOM is published in the reviewed sources.
